name: curator_render_report_markdown
notes: Report-to-markdown renderer (curator_ports.c vs LIVE agent/curator.py). Rungs only on the SHARED surface (B1 dict / B2 llm_error / B3 auto_transitions-dict); the C port is a REDUCED render — it omits the LLM-pass sections, list sections, and reads a `final_summary` key LIVE never uses, and formats duration as '%dm %ds' unconditionally. Inputs restricted to empty list sections, non-empty model/provider strings (LIVE falls back to '(not resolved)' on EMPTY STRINGS, C does not — excluded), and integer durations >= 0.
